title: Ruminations on Ruminants
statementMd:
Kevin Sun is ruminating on the origin of cows while standing at the origin of the Cartesian plane. He notices $*n*$ lines ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f1310215915a66820c9d13894fa2c93cd96f7574.png) on the plane, each representable by an equation of the form $*ax* + *by* = *c*$. He also observes that no two lines are parallel and that no three lines pass through the same point.

For each triple $(*i*, *j*, *k*)$ such that $1 ≤ *i* < *j* < *k* ≤ *n*$, Kevin considers the triangle formed by the three lines ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8e4a8191a77714531ab9dcb17efa7ff9ae56864e.png) . He calls a triangle original if the circumcircle of that triangle passes through the origin. Since Kevin believes that the circles of bovine life are tied directly to such triangles, he wants to know the number of original triangles formed by unordered triples of distinct lines.

Recall that the *circumcircle* of a triangle is the circle which passes through all the vertices of that triangle.

## Input

The first line of the input contains a single integer $*n*$ ($3 ≤ *n* ≤ 2000$), the number of lines.

The next $*n*$ lines describe lines ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6b12507ab308fc5b0834b34c9d32671a9348db9c.png). The $*i*$-th of these lines contains three space-separated integers $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}, *c*_{*i*}$ ($|*a*_{*i*}|, |*b*_{*i*}|, |*c*_{*i*}| ≤ 10 000, *a*_{*i*}^{2} + *b*_{*i*}^{2} > 0$), representing the equation $*a*_{*i*}*x* + *b*_{*i*}*y* = *c*_{*i*}$ of line ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c2122939f03c3297aea4d77af17943d88a2e48ea.png).

## Output

Print a single integer, the number of triples $(*i*, *j*, *k*)$ with $*i* < *j* < *k*$ such that lines ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8e4a8191a77714531ab9dcb17efa7ff9ae56864e.png) form an original triangle.

## Note

Note that in the first sample, some of the lines pass through the origin.

In the second sample, there is exactly one triple of lines: $*y* = 1, *x* + *y* = 2, *x* - *y* =  - 2.$ The triangle they form has vertices $(0, 2), (1, 1), ( - 1, 1)$. The circumcircle of this triangle has equation $*x*^{2} + (*y* - 1)^{2} = 1$. This indeed passes through $(0, 0).$
statementZhMd:
Kevin Sun 站在笛卡尔平面的原点，思考着牛的起源。他注意到平面上有 $*n*$ 条直线 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f1310215915a66820c9d13894fa2c93cd96f7574.png)，每条直线都可以表示为 $*ax* + *by* = *c*$ 的形式。他还观察到，任意两条直线都不平行，且任意三条直线不会交于同一点。

对于满足 $1 ≤ *i* < *j* < *k* ≤ *n*$ 的每个三元组 $(*i*, *j*, *k*)$，Kevin 考虑由三条直线 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8e4a8191a77714531ab9dcb17efa7ff9ae56864e.png) 所围成的三角形。如果该三角形的外接圆经过原点，他就称这个三角形是原始三角形。由于 Kevin 认为牛的生命循环与这样的三角形有着直接联系，他想知道由不同直线的无序三元组构成的原始三角形数量。

回顾一下，三角形的*外接圆*是经过该三角形所有顶点的圆。

## 输入格式

输入的第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$3 ≤ *n* ≤ 2000$），表示直线的数量。

接下来的 $*n*$ 行描述直线 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/6b12507ab308fc5b0834b34c9d32671a9348db9c.png)。其中第 $*i*$ 行包含三个用空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{*i*}, *b*_{*i*}, *c*_{*i*}$（$|*a*_{*i*}|, |*b*_{*i*}|, |*c*_{*i*}| ≤ 10 000, *a*_{*i*}^{2} + *b*_{*i*}^{2} > 0$），表示直线 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c2122939f03c3297aea4d77af17943d88a2e48ea.png) 的方程 $*a*_{*i*}*x* + *b*_{*i*}*y* = *c*_{*i*}$。

## 输出格式

输出一个整数，表示满足 $*i* < *j* < *k*$ 且直线 ![image](https://espresso.codeforces.com/8e4a8191a77714531ab9dcb17efa7ff9ae56864e.png) 构成原始三角形的三元组 $(*i*, *j*, *k*)$ 的数量。

## 说明

注意，在第一个样例中，有些直线经过原点。

在第二个样例中，恰好存在一个直线三元组：$*y* = 1, *x* + *y* = 2, *x* - *y* =  - 2$。它们构成的三角形顶点为 $(0, 2), (1, 1), ( - 1, 1)$。这个三角形的外接圆方程为 $*x*^{2} + (*y* - 1)^{2} = 1$。该圆确实经过 $(0, 0)$。
